gbm_population_evidence.quote: Pathologically confirmed glioblastoma (including all histological variants; documentation to be provided)

candidate_evidence.quote: A Study of Selinexor in Combination With Standard of Care Therapy for Newly Diagnosed or Recurrent Glioblastoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in patients with nGBM (Arms A and B) or with rGBM (Arm C)

role_evidence.quote: This is a Phase 1/2 study of selinexor in combination with standard of care (SoC) therapy

agents.drug_class_hint: XPO1 inhibitor (selective inhibitor of nuclear export)

role_evidence.quote: Participants with nGBM mMGMT will receive 75 mg/m\^2 of temozolomide oral capsule QD in combination with 2 Gy RT daily for 5 days per week
Participants with rGBM uMGMT or mMGMT will receive 110 mg/m\^2 of lomustine or 200 mg/m\^2 of Carmustine (substituted if lomustine is not available)

agents.drug_class_hint: nitrosourea alkylating agent, standard of care

role_evidence.quote: Participants with rGBM uMGMT or mMGMT will receive 110 mg/m\^2 of lomustine or 200 mg/m\^2 of Carmustine (substituted if lomustine is not available)

agents.drug_class_hint: nitrosourea alkylating agent, standard of care (IV, substitute for lomustine)

role_evidence.quote: Participants with rGBM will receive 60-80 mg of selinexor oral tablet QW across dose level -1, 1 and 10 mg/kg of Bevacizumab intravenous (IV) infusion every 2 weeks (Q2W)

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody, standard of care in recurrent GBM

source_quote.quote: Participants with nGBM uMGMT will receive 60 to 80 milligram (mg) of selinexor oral tablet once weekly (QW)
Participants with nGBM mMGMT will receive 40-80 mg of selinexor oral tablet QW across dose level -1, 1, 2, 2a, 2b and 3a
Participants with mutated isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) should be excluded for Phase 2.

coder_notes: Five experimental arms, each selinexor plus a standard backbone (RT, RT+TMZ, lomustine/carmustine, bevacizumab, TTFields), so selinexor is the only investigational agent in each. Bevacizumab, lomustine and carmustine are used as backbone in the selinexor arms (no schedule/dose question), so soc_backbone. Radiotherapy and TTField device are not listed as agents. IDH-mutant exclusion applies only to Phase 2. Plasma Cmax only: tumour PK no.
